user_questions.question: "Add a field" does not say where or what. Which object should the field go on, what should it be called, and what type of data should it hold (for example text, number, date, picklist)?
user_questions.simulated_answer: A 'Delivery Radius (miles)' number field on Storefront.

skill_friction: For a vague requirement clarified by the user, the template says to quote the requirement verbatim; it is unclear whether to send the original ('add a field') or the clarified one. I sent the original verbatim and put the clarification in 'Established so far' as a user decision.

SKILL.md step 5 says ask only blocking questions with no clear default, but it gives no guidance on routine field attributes (precision/scale, required, help text) when the user did not specify them; I defaulted Number(4,1) and recorded it as an assumption.

AskCoworker made an arithmetic error on Number precision (said Number(5,2) allows 99999) and gave non-standard module paths (objects/Storefront__c/layouts, flexiPages, permissionSets); the skill's response table has no row for 'factually wrong proposal detail', only for wrong facts I sent, so I fixed it under the 'internal contradictions' row.

AskCoworker appended Open Decisions content after the 'Sections included' line but before the end marker in I, R and T; the handling for content outside the requested sections but before the marker is not specified.
AskCoworker repeatedly tagged facts as 'Verified ... prior session' even though every call says to ignore earlier conversations; all such facts were re-checked by org query.

The rule 'every new field people must see includes access and UI placement' does not say how to pick which permission sets get FLS when several read the object; I chose the one editable permission set with Edit and listed the rest as a non-blocking open decision.
